facts.value: A friend of Donoghue ordered an opaque bottle of ginger beer in a café. After consuming half of it, Donoghue poured the remainder into a tumbler and found decomposing remains of a snail. She claimed to have suffered from shock and sued the manufacturer for carelessly allowing the drink to be contaminated.

facts.value: The liability for negligence is based upon a general public sentiment of moral wrongdoing for which the offender must pay.

facts.value: Stevenson owed Donoghue a duty of care to provide safe drinks.
